title: About the Stock Performance Analytics Portal
text:
Project Overview
This portal hosts a fully interactive, client-side financial analytics dashboard. It is compiled statically using Quarto and is designed to be hosted directly on GitHub Pages with zero server-side dependencies.


Technology Stack

Publisher: Quarto
Data Scraper: Custom Python requests & pandas engine (nasdaq_scraper.py)
Charts: Interactive ApexCharts.js (synchronized price & volume charts)
UI/Styles: Custom CSS built using a tailwind-inspired dark space palette and modern typography (Google Font Inter).



Core Features

Tabbed Multi-Security Navigation: Switch dynamically between Apple (AAPL), Tesla (TSLA), NVIDIA (NVDA), Amazon (AMZN), Disney (DIS), and Microsoft (MSFT).
Infinite Zoom-Out Range: The timeline charts contain all 5 years of daily/weekly history, enabling users to zoom out or pan freely, regardless of the active selection range.
Subtle Technical Overlays: Integrated 50-day (pink) and 200-day (orange) Simple Moving Average (SMA) lines with customized transparency and thickness (3.0px width, 50% opacity).
Historical Return Performance: A dedicated table showing percentage return changes over calendar intervals (6 months, 3 months, 1 month, 2 weeks, and 1 week).
Dynamic Narrative Report: Automatic trend detection (Bullish, Bearish, Consolidating) with a quantitative summary narrative.
CSV Exporter: Instantly download the active timeframe’s raw data as a CSV.



Data Retrieval & Re-compilation
To update the underlying dataset or add more securities: 1. Run the scraper: bash    python3 nasdaq_scraper.py --ticker <TICKER> --output-prefix downloads/<ticker>_nasdaq_dataset --format both 2. Re-run the compiler and render the site: bash    python3 generate_dashboard.py    quarto render
